test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - Reasoning(Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six friends are sitting in a circle facing the centre. Sumit sits second to the right of Amit. Karan is an immediate neighbour of Param. Tony sits third to the right of Amit. Dharam is an immediate neighbour of Amit and Sumit. Karan sits second to the right of Sumit.

Who sits fourth to the right of Param?
solution:
Given: Six friends are sitting in a circle facing the center

1) Karan sits second to the right of Sumit 

2) Sumit sits second to the right of Amit

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c345e0892ff0dacf075f01081a0a415abf9923d46ab530262019a1cac67c2530.png] 

3) Tony sits third to the right of Amit

4) Dharam is an immediate neighbor of Amit and Sumit

5) Karan is an immediate neighbor of Param

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/811d86afeda31207ab9bf83ff3dee0fad8d289b2c1ea95d265ff175d20ee01cc.png] 

So, Tony sits fourth to the right of Param

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
